category: debrid link generator with torrent and usenet backends

free_tier.stated: No free allowance on this plan; it is the US$10/month top tier. The free plan is a separate record.

per_object_cap.stated: 1 TB per download on the pricing page, 500 GiB in the API error table; the smaller figure is kept
per_object_cap.notes: The pricing page says '1TB Max Per Download Size'; the API error table says 'Pro Plan Limit: 536870912000 bytes' (500 GiB). Two vendor pages disagree by a factor of two and the record keeps the smaller.

retention.stated: 1 TB permanent storage (AirLock) and 30-day seeding time; after 30 days the torrent stops seeding but stays cached

egress.terms: 'Unlimited Downloads' and 'Unlimited Usenet Downloads + NNTP'. The terms say 'Unlimited' means no fixed ordinary-use limit, not unlimited automation or resale.

interface_detail: REST API with a bearer key; 300 requests per minute per token unless an endpoint is listed otherwise.
tooling: Documented API, Postman collection, third-party media-server integrations; NZB and NNTP credentials are issued through the API.
chaining: The only TorBox tier with usenet, so it is the one that competes with Premiumize on a second network: torrents plus NNTP plus 1 TB of stored files for US$10, against Premiumize's point budget at EUR 9.99.

limits.value: 500 GiB per download per the API table, 1 TB per the pricing page
ten active downloads or seeds, the maximum offered on any plan
300 requests per minute per token; 60 per hour for uncached torrent, usenet and web-download creation

limits_note: The API returns MONTHLY_LIMIT, COOLDOWN_LIMIT and ACTIVE_LIMIT as distinct errors, so a client can tell a monthly cap from a concurrency wait without parsing prose.
binding_note: There is no monthly byte quota to hit, and ten concurrent slots is not a quota in this vocabulary. The single object is what fails: a 1 TiB torrent cannot be added at all if the 500 GiB API figure is the enforced one, which is the smaller of the two published numbers.

identity_cost.detail: E-mail account plus card or voucher at checkout.

reliability_note: TorBox has a public status page and a documented history of downtime; the abuse system is dynamic and keyed to a rolling 99th percentile, so a heavy month can be throttled without a published threshold.
confidence_note: Price and plan features are from the pricing page; the size figure is the API's, which is lower.

evidence.proved: '$10/mo', '10 Concurrent Slots', '1TB Max Per Download Size', '80Gbps Speed', '30 Day Seeding Time', '1TB Permanent Storage', 'Unlimited Usenet Downloads + NNTP'
'Pro Plan Limit: 536870912000 bytes', 300/min general rate limit, 60/hour for usenet and web-download creation, and the MONTHLY_LIMIT / COOLDOWN_LIMIT / ACTIVE_LIMIT error codes
Pro: '1TB per torrent allowance', '10 active torrents', 'Access to Usenet', '30 day seeding time', and that 10 is the hard maximum across all plans
'Unlimited' does not mean unlimited automation, resale or commercial exploitation; fair-use limits and throttling are reserved

price_per_tb_month: USD 10.00 per 30 days, flat, usenet included
notes: The 500 GiB versus 1 TB conflict is the interesting part: the same vendor publishes both, and the API table is the one an automated client will actually hit. Annual plans exist (a November 2025 promotion sold them at 30% off: Essential US$23.10, Standard US$38.50, Pro US$77, implying list prices near US$33 / US$55 / US$110) but the pricing page read shows monthly only.

extras.annual_plan: exists; list price not shown, promo implies about USD 110
